questions.stem: Find the area of curve \(y = \sin x\) bounded by \(x = 0\) and \(x = 2\pi\)

hi.stem: \(x = 0\) एवं \(x = 2\pi\) तथा वक्र \(y = \sin x\) से घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.subtopic: Order and Degree of a Differential Equation
questions.stem:
Find the order and degree of the differential equation
\(\left(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\right)^3 + \left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)^2 + \sin\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right) + 1 = 0\)

hi.stem: अवकल समीकरण \(\left(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\right)^3 + \left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)^2 + \sin\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right) + 1 = 0\) की कोटि और घात ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Find the area of parallelogram whose adjacent sides are given by \(\vec{a} = 3\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 4\hat{k}\) and \(\vec{b} = \hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\)

hi.stem: उस समान्तर चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए, जिसकी संलग्न भुजाएँ \(\vec{a} = 3\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 4\hat{k}\) और \(\vec{b} = \hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\) द्वारा दी गयी है।

questions.stem: If \(A^2 = A\), then simplify \((I + A)^2 - 7A\), where \(A\) is square matrix.

hi.stem: यदि \(A^2 = A\) हो, तो \((I + A)^2 - 7A\) को सरल कीजिए, जहाँ \(A\) एक वर्ग आव्यूह है।

If three vectors \(\vec{a}, \vec{b}\) and \(\vec{c}\) satisfying the condition \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c} = 0\). If \(|\vec{a}| = 3, |\vec{b}| = 4\) and \(|\vec{c}| = 5\), then find the value of \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}\).

hi.stem: तीन सदिश \(\vec{a}, \vec{b}\) और \(\vec{c}\) प्रतिबंध \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c} = 0\) को संतुष्ट करते हैं। यदि \(|\vec{a}| = 3, |\vec{b}| = 4\) और \(|\vec{c}| = 5\) हो, तो \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Find the angle between the lines \(\vec{r} = 3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 4\hat{k} + \lambda(\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 2\hat{k})\) and \(\vec{r} = 5\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + \mu(3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 6\hat{k})\)

hi.stem: रेखाओं \(\vec{r} = 3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 4\hat{k} + \lambda(\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 2\hat{k})\) तथा \(\vec{r} = 5\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + \mu(3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 6\hat{k})\) के मध्य कोण ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem:
Minimize \(z = 3x + 2y\) under the following constraints by graphical method.
\(x + y \geq 8, \quad x \geq 0\)
\(3x + 5y \leq 15, \quad y \geq 0\)

hi.stem:
निम्नलिखित व्यवरोधों के अन्तर्गत \(z = 3x + 2y\) का न्यूनतमीकरण ग्राफीय विधि से कीजिए।
\(x + y \geq 8, \quad x \geq 0\)
\(3x + 5y \leq 15, \quad y \geq 0\)

questions.stem: If the function \(f : \left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right] \rightarrow R\) is given by \(f(x) = \cos x\) and function \(g : \left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right] \rightarrow R\) is given by \(g(x) = \sin x\), then prove that \(f\) and \(g\) are one-one but \(f + g\) are not one-one.

hi.stem: यदि फलन \(f : \left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right] \rightarrow R, f(x) = \cos x\) तथा फलन \(g : \left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right] \rightarrow R, g(x) = \sin x\) द्वारा परिभाषित है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए की \(f\) तथा \(g\) एकैकी है, किन्तु \(f + g\) एकैकी नहीं है।

questions.stem: A family has two children. If it is known that at least one child is boy out of two children, then find the probability of becoming boy out of two children.

questions._flag: The English asks for 'the probability of becoming boy out of two children' while the Hindi clearly asks for both children being boys; each kept as printed.
